description: Renders a QR code as an SVG element. Supports custom size, foreground/background colors, and multiple error correction levels.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The text or URL to encode.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The size in pixels. Default is 200.

parameters.name: ErrorCorrectionLevel
parameters.description: Error correction level. Default is M (15% recovery).

parameters.name: ForegroundColor
parameters.description: Foreground color in hex format. Default is #000000.

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.description: Background color in hex format. Default is #ffffff.

examples.title: Large QR code with custom colors
